task: Cover the discussion page (`/`). A reader posts a comment; replies to a comment, and the reply appears nested under that comment (not under another one); edits a comment's text in place with Edit and Save; and deletes a comment after confirming the browser dialog, while dismissing the dialog keeps the comment. The counter under the heading counts replies too (`3 comments`). Comments, edits and deletions are stored on the server and survive a reload.

faults.description: Posting a comment changes nothing on the page until a reload.

faults.brief_phrase: nested under that comment (not under another one)
faults.description: Every reply is stored under the first top-level comment instead of the one replied to.
faults.replace: parentId: parentId === null ? null : comments.find((c) => c.parentId === null).id

faults.brief_phrase: dismissing the dialog keeps the comment
faults.description: The comment is deleted whether the dialog is confirmed or dismissed.
Save shows the new text but the server keeps the old one.
